stories.title: News live: Hanson says Australians should be able to use super for cost-of-living pressures
stories.summary: Follow live updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The One Nation leader, Pauline Hanson , says compulsory superannuation rules are too rigid in Australia and called for people under financial pressure or trying to buy their first home to get access to their retirement savings. “A lot of Australians are doing it tough now and struggling to pay off their mortgages,” Hanson told News24. In some ways, I feel that you should give them their money now, and let them help them with the cost of living. It is their money; they’ve they’ve sacrificed it in lieu of pay. So, in a lot of cases, people want it. We will need to work through the additional Foundational Supports.
